## Validation

Candidate: [`85206b1c22dab78e8379d7a10e2f2b9ac31af9c6`](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/85206b1c22dab78e8379d7a10e2f2b9ac31af9c6). Base: `845cec3060b0880cd27c36047f1da57a1c3772ba`. Tested source was committed at `185e372a`; the final commit adds only the immutable base metric record. Per-stage input maps retain their actual capture HEAD and times. All executable inputs and exact legal bytes match the final candidate; two later proposal status-note edits are identified in the provenance record.

Selection: `src/` changes select the full ordinary suite, typecheck, portal build,
applicable container/hosted build and live gates, plus dedicated PostgreSQL and
Collector gates under `test-gate-policy.md`. All reported passing test runs below
have zero failed, cancelled, skipped and todo tests unless stated otherwise.

| Check | Status and result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `npm test` | **PASS**, final source: 4,750 backend tests and 49 portal tests; exit 0. Inputs unchanged during run. | [Final results](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/final-checks/results.json), [log](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/final-checks/ordinary.log) |
| `npm run typecheck`; `npm run build:user-portal` | **PASS**, final source, exit 0 each; inputs unchanged. | [Per-stage input manifests](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/review-draft/validation-provenance.json) |

**History and provenance.** The initial ordinary/type/portal/hosted-offline and
self-hosted-container runs passed on their captured inputs. The final runs above replace their stale ordinary/type/portal/image/offline evidence.
All five final stages report `inputsChangedDuringRun: []`. Initial hosted-offline
counts were
3,064 + 29 + 20 + 1,070 + 119 + 13, all passed. Initial inputs differ from final
source in exactly `members-style.ts` and the service test's seed-row assertion.
All final per-stage source/test/SQL fingerprints match current files; the
[provenance record](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/review-draft/validation-provenance.json)
pins each full input-map hash and preserves the earlier map.

The obsolete image context loaded at 23:49:06 UTC, before the 23:50:20 CSS fix.
The manager cancelled it at 00:18:57 UTC with SIGINT: inner build exit 130, outer
gate exit 1. This was a deliberate stale-context cancellation, not a product
failure or a pass. [Cancellation record](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/checks/obsolete-image-cancellation.json).

Expected red checks and failed attempts are retained: initial dataset Save and
unit failures; missing-column PostgreSQL failures plus a concurrent clean-build
output conflict; Collector 9/10 before its subprocess forwarded dataset; help
and browser-pattern reds; and the seed-row test's strip-only TypeScript tooling
failure before its successful `--import tsx` rerun. Raw worker logs are archived;
the earliest Admin 400/303 and five unit reds survive only in tool transcripts.
No failure is replaced by a later pass without its cause and retry history.
[Prior description/comments](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/review-draft/pr248-initial-evidence.json)
retain the initial published evidence; it is historical, not current approval.

The precommit metric process failed at Delta because the native base comparison
could not check out `origin/main` with the dirty candidate. Review, CRAP and
Architecture did not run, and coverage had not started. The documented clean-tree
requirement led to committing the tested candidate, then starting the normal
process with coverage. The clean-candidate retry completed all stages; this earlier failure is preserved and is not a metric exception. [Failure log](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/metrics-precommit.log),
[failed process](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/metrics-precommit-failed.json).

**Whitespace review.** The global staged whitespace check exited 2: 62 findings
were individually reviewed and retained—54 unified-diff blank context markers
and eight Markdown hard breaks in the frozen Terms/Privacy and runtime literals.
All other candidate paths passed the scoped check (exit 0). This is not an
unqualified global whitespace PASS. [Each finding and reason](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/whitespace-review.json).

**Coverage and limits.** The verified unit capture at `185e372a` includes both complete unit parts (3,064 backend and 29 portal tests). It records Node 24.20.0, TypeScript 7.0.2, source/input/build fingerprints and capture ID `14c8338ba7ac155d79fa80b84065593d7a0b63015edf85eb914150d71ae8ede1`. Final reuse passed compatibility without relabelling the capture. [Coverage and provenance](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/quality/coverage.json). Original raw V8 captures are retained locally; this package publishes the normalized verified report. Two source mappings remain unknown and pass from proven bounds, as Quality review explains. No standalone
`npm run check` or broad interface/integration/acceptance repeat is added. The
hosted build already selects both local renderer files. System Axiom, Brave live,
paid billing, MFA and the self-hosted evaluation release are outside this delta.
Habit Hooks dispositions and approval evidence belong in **Quality review**. GitHub reports no remote check/status entries for this exact head; that is not a CI pass. [Remote readback](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/github-candidate-checks.json).

**Release-only work remains.** Real restricted-role SQL/TLS, local store conflict/
isolation/reconnect, Render CA/read access, one Axiom transport receipt and a
deployed MCP baseline are recorded in the ledger. They do not prove the final
deployed Save/Test/Enable, restart, MCP/Admin export and Axiom receipt journey.
No extra production organization is required solely to manufacture v3 acceptance;
the existing-org disposition and precise presentation limits remain recorded in
the [release audit](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/release-gate-review.md).
Exact notice approval, public/in-app publication readback, existing-organization
handling, current-source deployment and specific S1 limitation dispositions remain.
No backup gate applies: the owner moved recovery to Slice 4. [Direct human approval](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/a7284b0c4dc02a8c7cd7958cfdc4a11ce4adee89/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/approvals/owner-approval.json) now covers the current head and complete notice package. These checks do not themselves prove live release or durable delivery. The approved publication and deployed journey remain to be performed.

## Quality review

Candidate: [`85206b1c22dab78e8379d7a10e2f2b9ac31af9c6`](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/85206b1c22dab78e8379d7a10e2f2b9ac31af9c6).
Base: [`845cec3060b0880cd27c36047f1da57a1c3772ba`](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/845cec3060b0880cd27c36047f1da57a1c3772ba).
**T2 Need architect.** Architecture: T2: declarations changed in 2 public
modules; 5 registry views edited. The final local checker is eligible with no
blockers. Overall merge is **eligible**. The owner directly approved this exact head as architect, accepted the stated S1 limits for the internal rollout, and approved the complete notice package and existing-organization disposition. [Exact human answers and scope](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/a7284b0c4dc02a8c7cd7958cfdc4a11ce4adee89/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/approvals/owner-approval.json). Agent review is separate from this human approval. Actual publication and deployed delivery proof remain pending.

**Tier reasons and impact.** T2 reasons are
`architecture.declarations_changed` for `destination-settings-service.ts`
(+3 −1 declaration lines) and `audit-send.ts` (+1),
`architecture.registry_view_changed` for five edited views, and `impact.contract`.
T1 reasons are `protected_paths.deploy_and_data` for
`Dockerfile.hosted.dockerignore` and `impact.sensitiveBehavior`. All six reasons
are retained; the highest tier controls. No component set, component dependency,
runtime process or container is added; System logging keeps its separate owner
and transport. The final checker reports no undeclared facts, no blockers and no
exception use. [Final checker](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/quality/pr-review.json).

The [committed impact declaration](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/85206b1c22dab78e8379d7a10e2f2b9ac31af9c6/.pr-impact.json) and [stamped input](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/quality/impact.json) describe this complete candidate against its actual main base.

The checker's seven informational notes each have a disposition: 48 public
modules with two changed snapshots are verified declaration scope;
`OtlpAuditSender` is touched with declarations unchanged, so its type contract
adds no third declaration fact. Its three changed imports (`audit-send`,
`public-audit-destination`, `otlp-audit-request`) still need semantic review:
they carry and validate the optional dataset through the existing sender, as
covered by the authority, header and lifetime review below. Size notes are
436 production lines versus 400 and 3,223 total non-generated lines versus 1,500.
The frozen legal literal bundle, canonical legal data and operational/review
documents explain much of this volume; the small routing field remains within
existing owners. The metric and Habit Hooks reviews retain specific cohesion
reasons rather than extract code merely to reduce size. These are notes, not
extra human tiers. The final checker also warns that local eligibility is
preliminary: the manager must verify current checks, holds and human approval.

**Policy answers.** The changed client/operator promise is one optional saved
Axiom dataset, forwarded only from the authorized current tenant/revision. Blank
or omitted dataset retains generic OTLP behavior. Save remains atomic; Test does
not save or enable. Dataset-only edits advance revision, stale queued work is
dropped, and already-authorized in-flight work may finish. Header syntax is
validated at both Admin and sender boundaries before remote work. The existing
Admin, Origin/CSRF, tenant predicates, public-address/DNS/pinned peer and verified
TLS rules remain. Token retention requires unchanged endpoint/auth; auth None clears
the token. Dataset and credentials remain outside event bodies and System settings.
The new bundle changes displayed legal versions/hashes, with one unchecked
creator checkbox and stale-form refusal. Existing acceptance records are kept;
no new acceptance by existing users is claimed.

The image adds the three canonical v3 inputs required by its exact-byte tests.
Stored settings add nullable `axiom_dataset`; apply the additive migration before
the new adapter. Old code can read its original columns but ignores the dataset
and cannot perform direct Axiom routing. Disable export before rollback to that
code and retain the schema and encryption key; schema compatibility alone does
not prove equivalent delivery. No new dependency or production System exporter
is introduced. Recovery/backup moves to future Slice 4 by owner instruction;
this slice has no settings backup. Export remains bounded best effort with
possible loss/duplicates and no event history/replay.

**Metrics.** The complete 185e372a analysis finished all four stages: retained
Delta/Review/CRAP goal misses (exit 1), Architecture pass. Ten existing production
MI misses and one high/eight medium findings each have a specific retained reason
in [metric dispositions](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/metrics-dispositions.md); no mechanical
extraction is justified. The high integration test keeps the actual queued
revision/dataset oracle visible. The 346-line legal bundle is frozen literal
data, not equivalent branching complexity. Final process and standalone CRAP retain exit 1 for those raw goal misses; the
final checker accepts the applicable goals and reports no exception use.
[Final process](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/quality/process.md),
[CRAP rows](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/quality/crap.json),
[review data](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/quality/review.json).

Measured changed/new CRAP rows meet applicable hard goals. The two changed target
suggestions, 17.1 and 15.002737575, remain below 30. Two source coverage unknowns
remain explicit: changed `requestAuditExport` and conservatively new Pg close
closure, each one path. Emitted calls do not supply missing source identity;
the unchanged Pg closure cannot be paired uniquely and was not invoked by unit
coverage. Both worst-case ranges [1,2] prove even the new goal under the checker;
no new exception is needed. The final JSON keeps coverage unknown, and the
checker explicitly confirms both bound passes. Preserve the process's unknown
status and exit 1. The one unchanged unknown hosted closure stays
`unchanged by this PR`. [Complete source analysis](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/metrics-source-185e372a-process.md),
[raw review](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/metrics-source-185e372a-review.json).

Verified coverage was captured at 185e372a, for both complete unit parts, with
source/input/runtime/compiler and suite fingerprints. Final reuse after the
history commit passed compatibility checks; the capture is not relabelled.
Base CRAP derived with head coverage is an estimate; no measured base coverage
is claimed. The native dependency report retains the same unresolved CSS asset import at both revisions; it cannot prove a complete graph from that evidence alone. Global and component
unknowns remain; no component average proves a function goal. Worker PG/Collector
runs have limited individual-file/chronological provenance, not full head-bound
input manifests. [Validation](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/248#issuecomment-6390817756)
keeps complete gate, failure/retry and coverage provenance.

**Habit Hooks and manual review.** All 92 retained locations have reasons:
10 complexity, 15 non-null assertions, three parameter counts, 59 comments and
five sizes. The one weak test setup was fixed with `assert.ok(current)`, then
passed its 39-case rerun and the complete gates. The final committed Hook rerun
has the same 92 findings, with only the oversized-list order changed. Snooze
remains `[]`.
[Each disposition](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/habit-review.md).
The global staged whitespace check exited 2 with 62 individually reviewed
intentional findings: 54 unified-diff context markers and eight frozen legal
Markdown hard breaks. Remaining paths passed the scoped check, exit 0; this is
not a blanket global pass. [Every whitespace reason](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/whitespace-review.json).

<details>
<summary>Architecture provenance and review</summary>

All 13 registry diagrams were inventoried; views 1,2,6,7,13 changed. The focused
L3 and changed registry views were parsed, rendered and inspected at 800px;
the manager accepted all six images. The single authoritative comparison remains
in the main description. [Versioned review](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/architecture/v4/review.md)
and [manifest](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/architecture/v4/candidate-manifest.json) retain
actual compared code, registry and diagram bytes. Versions 1–3 preserve the earlier reviews; v4 binds all 60 changed files and the full source tree to the committed candidate. Diagram sources and all six renders are byte-identical. The final binding in
[manager record](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/manager-review-final.json) binds the review
to the final candidate without relabelling the earlier capture.
L4 is omitted because L3 plus the authority/payload/revision/lifetime notes answer
the strongest changed callable contract, `AuditDestination.axiomDataset`.
No test-helper API creates a production L4 requirement. The Docker-context and
queued-forwarding findings are fixed; no production correctness finding remains
in that reviewed scope. No new architecture decision record was requested; the optional field extends the existing destination contract and runtime roles. The observed client-to-pooler TLS limit remains explicit in v4. This does not prove deployment or notice approval.

</details>

Prior published evidence and approval history remain in the
[archived initial report](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/257baca8b985083e6a7f3ab7c7c3e40642a445c0/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/review-draft/pr248-initial-evidence.json).
It is historical, not current-head approval. The subsequent direct human approval is recorded [separately](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/a7284b0c4dc02a8c7cd7958cfdc4a11ce4adee89/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/approvals/owner-approval.json). No de-escalation is requested.

marketing.body:
The public policies still describe the earlier hosted service. This change publishes the complete organization Audit Terms and Privacy from Thermus review bundle `s204-organization-audit-proposal-2026-10-24-v3`, with the proposed effective date of 24 October 2026. It adds the reviewed optional Audit export, redaction and delivery limits, destination handling, Supabase settings, direct Axiom routing, and no-backup Slice 2 disclosures.

**Approved for publication.** The owner directly approved this exact Marketing head, the complete v3 package, effective date of 24 October 2026, public/runtime publication scope, no-backup scope and existing internal Thermus AI organization disposition. [Recorded human approval](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/a7284b0c4dc02a8c7cd7958cfdc4a11ce4adee89/ast-report/s2-04-rollout/approvals/owner-approval.json). Prior agreement records are retained; no new signup acceptance is claimed.

The complete Markdown files are copied byte-for-byte from the Thermus proposal. The Astro wrappers change only version and hash attributes. The existing layout, links, routes, homepage, pricing, waitlist, contact form, and guides remain unchanged. The existing rendering test oracle uses the new candidate identifiers; no prose tests or dependencies were added.

| Document | Review version | Bytes | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Terms | `hosted-terms-organization-audit-proposal-2026-10-24-v3` | 19,946 | `ce5f1afb9ac2759117b722a4d819b6207f23e2ff99f15d09a5abbd9e1b32eee3` |
| Privacy | `hosted-privacy-organization-audit-proposal-2026-10-24-v3` | 35,098 | `692801219c0ac19c50300cd188cfd2ca55cb7e89caaba656269e484b44d4dcc6` |

Validation: Node 24.20.0, locked `npm ci`, and `npm run check` passed: typecheck, all 62 existing tests, and build. Both local production and preview-context builds preserve every policy word, punctuation mark, link, table cell, and the new date. Chromium with JavaScript disabled checked both pages at 375 and 1,280 pixels: one H1, complete anchors, direct email/footer links, readable Audit text and tables, and no horizontal overflow. Byte comparison and SHA-256 match the proposal. `git diff --check` passed. Homepage: 113.1 KB gzip/200 KB; JavaScript: 3.50 KB/10 KB.

The commit and PR title contain `[skip netlify]` under [Netlify's skip-deploy instructions](https://docs.netlify.com/deploy/manage-deploys/manage-deploys-overview/#skip-a-deploy), preventing automatic branch/production and Deploy Preview builds. This was the preparation hold. The approved merge will use an explicit commit title and body without a skip directive so production Git deployment can run. Local validation is not deployed evidence.
